restaurants.name: Ponta da Piedade
restaurants.specialty: The Algarve's most iconic rock formations. Arrive at 7:30am for sunrise without the crowds.

restaurants.name: Lagos Old Town
restaurants.specialty: Medieval walls, cobblestone streets, Dom Sebastião and A Tasca do Kiko for lunch.

restaurants.name: Praia do Camilo
restaurants.specialty: 200 wooden steps to a cliff-framed double cove. Rock tunnel connects to a second beach at low tide.

restaurants.name: Benagil Cave (Boat Tour)
restaurants.specialty: Book the earliest departure (7:30am). By 11am there are 15+ boats queuing to enter.

restaurants.name: Praia da Marinha
restaurants.specialty: Consistently rated top 10 in Europe. Arrive before 10am. The double arch is extraordinary.

restaurants.name: Carvoeiro & Algar Seco
restaurants.specialty: Postcard-perfect village. Walk the boardwalk to Algar Seco's otherworldly rock formations.

restaurants.name: Ferragudo
restaurants.specialty: Prettiest fishing village on the central coast. Sunset at Praia Grande, dinner at O Pescador.

restaurants.name: Fortaleza de Sagres
restaurants.address: Fortaleza de Sagres, Vila do Bispo
restaurants.specialty: Henry the Navigator's fortress on a windswept promontory at the edge of Europe.

restaurants.name: Praia do Tonel
restaurants.specialty: Surf beach below the fortress. Dramatic cliffs, powerful waves, and Atlantic energy.

restaurants.name: Cape St. Vincent
restaurants.specialty: Continental Europe's southwestern tip. The 'last sunset in Europe' — don't miss it.

restaurants.name: Tavira Old Town
restaurants.specialty: The Algarve's most elegant town. Roman bridge, castle ruins, Camera Obscura tower.

restaurants.name: Casa do Polvo, Santa Luzia
restaurants.specialty: The octopus capital of Portugal. Polvo à lagareiro is legendary. Arrive at 12:30 sharp.

restaurants.name: Ilha de Tavira
restaurants.address: Ilha de Tavira (ferry from town centre)
restaurants.specialty: Barrier island beach. Warmer water, wider sand, Ria Formosa birdlife. Walk east for solitude.

restaurants.name: Silves Castle
restaurants.specialty: Best-preserved Moorish castle in the Algarve. Red sandstone walls, views over orange groves.

restaurants.name: Caldas de Monchique
restaurants.specialty: Hidden valley spa village with mineral-rich thermal springs, surrounded by forest.

restaurants.name: Fóia Peak (902m)
restaurants.specialty: Highest point in the Algarve. Panoramic views over both the south and west coasts.

restaurants.name: Faro Old Town (Cidade Velha)
restaurants.specialty: Medieval walled town with cathedral, Bone Chapel, and orange tree-lined squares.

restaurants.name: Ilha Deserta & O Estamine
restaurants.address: Ilha Deserta, Ria Formosa (ferry from Faro)
restaurants.specialty: 7km uninhabited island. Only restaurant: O Estamine — solar-powered, feet-in-the-sand dining.

restaurants.name: Olhão Markets
restaurants.specialty: The Algarve's most authentic fishing town. Two redbrick market halls, cubist architecture.

restaurants.name: Aljezur Castle
restaurants.specialty: Moorish ruins with 360° views over the valley and wild Atlantic coast.

restaurants.name: Praia da Arrifana
restaurants.specialty: Dramatic cliff amphitheatre, world-class surf, clifftop cafés with unbeatable views.

restaurants.name: Praia do Amado
restaurants.specialty: The Algarve's most consistent surf break. Red-ochre cliffs, wild energy, perfect final sunset.
